answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the comet of the next round.
